title: Adobe Creative Cloud Pricing 2026: Plans and Costs
summary: Adobe Creative Cloud pricing ranges from single-app to full-suite plans. See which subscription level matches your budget and workflow.
body_markdown:
## Automate Creative Cloud file handoffs with Activepieces


Do not expect Activepieces to lower your Adobe bill or tell you which plan to buy. It automates the paperwork around the seats you already pay for, such as filing exports, pinging reviewers and logging approvals, and its free self-hosted Community Edition is MIT-licensed.


Pick the plan first, using the checks above. Then ask whether your people are burning paid hours on copying and chasing.


Creative Cloud is Adobe's subscription bundle of design, photo, video and document apps. Everything it produces is a file that someone must name, store, send for sign-off and record.


### An example workflow


To see the idea, take Activepieces' own example, which runs as a single flow run at 1 credit however many steps it has. A new contact arrives in HubSpot, a customer-tracking tool, and an AI step judges whether the lead is worth pursuing.


A condition then routes it: qualified leads go to Salesforce, a sales database, with a Slack message to the team, while the rest get a loop of follow-up emails through Gmail.


Swap the lead for a finished export and the same shape works: a file lands, a reviewer is notified, the approval gets written down. The sequence is the point, and a design team can borrow it.


Because this section quotes no Adobe prices, none were checked for it. Activepieces has no say in them, and its own Plus plan is a separate flat $20 a month for 10,000 credits.


Before you renew, read the current figures on Adobe's own plan page, because they're the only ones that count.


Nobody sees the staff time spent hand-filing exports and chasing approvals on the invoice, but you pay it every month. Automating it won't change the plan's cost; it just stops the seat's real cost from creeping up unseen.
